በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ወነግሠ: ነግሠ — and he reigned (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ)
ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
ለምድር: ምድር — to/for the earth, or earth as object (ለ- + noun)
ኀልቁ: ኀልቀ — they came to an end, perished (3m pl perfect)
ዝውእቱ: ውእቱ — this is he, that is (he who) · 'this very one', ዝ + ውእቱ in apposition (ዝውእቱ ብሩሀ ገጽ ይኩን 'let this one, bright of face, be…')
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of

ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
እለብስ: ለብሰ — I will put on, clothe myself (imperf. 1s, l-b-s)
ወኣስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — and I will appear, reveal myself (r-ʾ-y caus.)
ለሊሁ: ለሊሁ — he himself, his very self
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n)
ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ነግሠ: ነግሠ — he reigned (3m sg perfect, n-g-š)
